THIS CRIMINAL PETITION IS FILED UNDER SECTION 482 OF THE CODE OF CRIMINAL PROCEDURE, 1973 PRAYING TO QUASH THE ENTIRE PROCEEDINGS AGAINST THESE PETITIONERS (ACCUSED NO.2 AND 4), PENDING BEFORE THE COURT OF CHIEF METROPLITAN MAGISTRATE, BENGALURU IN MAHALAXMI LAYOUT P.S., C.C.NO.3855/2023 FOR THE OFFENCES P/U/S 498A, 323, 504,
506 R/W SEC. 34 OF IPC, SEC. 3 AND 4 OF THE D.P. ACT,
(ANNEXURE-A) AND ETC.
 THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR ADMISSION, THIS DAY, THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 ORDER Learned HCGP accepts notice for respondent No.1-State.
2. Sri G. Mohan Kumar, learned counsel files power on behalf of respondent No.2 and the same is placed on record.
3. The petitioners accused Nos.2 and 4 are sought to be prosecuted for the offences punishable under sections 498A 323, 504, 506 r/w 34 IPC, and Sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.

4. The case of the prosecution is that, the petitioners subjected the defacto-complainant to cruelty,
both mentally and physically, and also a demand was made to bring money from her parental home.

5. The parties are present before this Court and have filed a joint affidavit through their respective counsel stating that marriage of accused No.1 with the defacto-complainant has been dissolved mutually and respondent No.2 - defacto complainant has agreed to withdraw all the allegations made NC: 2023:KHC:45998 against the petitioners and stated that she has no objection for quashing the impugned proceedings.
6. The joint affidavit is placed on record.

7. Though the offences alleged against the petitioners- accused herein are cognizable and non-compoundable, however, having regard to the fact that the parties have amicably settled the Vittal Saliyan vs The State Of Karnataka on 12 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/31449808/
2 dispute among themselves, and the respondent No.2 having no objection for quashing the impugned proceedings, it would be a futile exercise, if the petitioners are subjected to trial, since the probability of their conviction is remote and bleak in view of the settlement.

8. Accordingly, I pass the following:
ORDER i. The Criminal Petition is allowed;
ii. The impugned proceedings in C.C.No.3855/2023 pending on the file of the learned Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, Bengaluru, stands quashed.
